questions.stem: Who can typically perform Data Cleaning, and why?
options: Only database administrators, because it needs root access
Only external vendors, because it needs special tools
Only data scientists, because it needs machine learning
Business users themselves, because it requires little effort such as exporting data to Excel, cleaning it and sending it downstream
Nobody, because cleaning happens automatically
questions.explanation: Data cleaning can be done at a very high level by business users themselves as it requires little effort, for example exporting to Excel, cleaning and sending downstream.

questions.stem: Who is ideally placed to perform Data Cleansing?
options: Business users using Excel
IT subject-matter experts writing SQL queries at the database level
Customers correcting their own records
The marketing team using a survey
A regulator conducting an audit
questions.explanation: Cleansing can be done by business users, but ideally IT SMEs write SQL queries at the database level so the next extract is already cleansed.

questions.stem: Which activity is described as the best level for achieving the highest Data Quality?
options: Data Cleaning
Data Cleansing
Data Enrichment
Data Splitting
Data Scrubbing
questions.explanation: Scrubbing is described as the best level to achieve the highest Data Quality, making sure data is near to perfect.

questions.stem: In the face-care analogy used to explain the three levels of data cleaning, which situation corresponds to Data Scrubbing?
options: Going to a proper parlour with the best worker and creams before a wedding or valuable event
Wiping paint splashes off your face while painting
Washing dust off your face after a walk
Applying face cream for ten to fifteen minutes after a football match
Cleaning your face after eating
questions.explanation: Scrubbing is likened to preparing for a wedding or valuable event: a proper parlour, the best worker and the best creams to make sure the face is properly cleaned, cleansed and scrubbed.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT given as a reason to conduct Data Scrubbing?
options: Wrong data entry
Two or more databases being merged
The data having just been validated by an automated tool
Few or no standards defined in the system
Very old data that is not yet obsolete
questions.explanation: The reasons listed are wrong data entry, merged databases, few or no standards, and very old data; recently validated data is not a reason to scrub.

questions.stem: What happens to corrupt and bad data during a Data Scrubbing exercise?
options: It is permanently deleted without record
It is sent to customers for correction
It is left in place but flagged in a report
It is removed from the mainstream of data and parked separately for investigation
It is merged with good data to fill gaps
questions.explanation: During scrubbing, corrupt and bad data is removed from the mainstream and parked separately so it can be investigated.

questions.stem: According to the statistics cited in the discussion of Data Scrubbing, businesses lose up to what share of their revenue because of bad data quality?
questions.explanation: The cited statistic is that businesses lose up to 20% of their revenue because of bad data quality.

questions.stem: How much of their productive time do employees reportedly waste dealing with routine data quality tasks?
options: Up to half
Up to one tenth
Up to one quarter
Almost all of it
None, because tools handle it
questions.explanation: The cited statistic is that employees waste up to half of their productive time on routine data quality tasks.

questions.stem: According to the survey cited in the discussion of Data Scrubbing, what happens in any given hour of the day?
options: Every company changes its address
About 500 businesses close
No business names change
Fewer than five new businesses open
Almost five dozen companies change address, nearly a dozen change name, and over 40 new businesses open
questions.explanation: The survey states that in any hour almost five dozen companies change their addresses, nearly a dozen change their name and over 40 new businesses open.

questions.stem: In Data Scrubbing, across which range of systems should the findings be implemented?
options: Only in the reporting layer
Only in the spreadsheet where problems were found
From source systems through to downstream systems
Only in the staging area
Only in third-party systems
questions.explanation: Scrubbing means finding good tools and resources and making sure the findings are implemented from source to downstream systems.
